summary: Migration bridge materializes one declared future RED test without starting Quick Dev; supports slices W0-W6 with fixed templates and identifiers TWR-W0 through TWR-W6; reads implementation-contract.v1.json and requires matching slice, declared selector, planned file, and test write set; accepts exactly the current slice RED test snapshot; enforces repository/plan/test path boundaries and blocks traversal, logs, execution-plans, escapes, and conflicting existing content; only --materialize-only mode is valid; partial/invalid declarations raise errors; existing identical test is reused; new test is written with UTF-8 LF; CLI emits materialized status, slice ID, path, and empty authorizations; ambiguities: behavior depends on contract contents and template/API availability.
